#splash.short{--k:.5}
.sp-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;height:100%}
.sp-ext{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;width:100%;position:relative}
.sp-ext i{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;bottom:0;width:2px;margin-left:-1px;background:#ff2036;box-shadow:0 0 8px 1px rgba(255,32,54,.8),0 0 22px 4px rgba(255,32,54,.35);transform:scaleY(0)}
.sp-top i{transform-origin:top;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#000 85%);mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#000 85%)}

.sp-stage{position:relative;flex:none;width:min(100vw,calc(100vh*.5628));width:min(100vw,calc(100dvh*.5628));aspect-ratio:941/1672}
.sp-img{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--sp) center/100% 100% no-repeat;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.sp-main{clip-path:inset(0 0 100% 0)}

.sp-tip{clip-path:inset(56% 42% 29% 42%);opacity:0;filter:brightness(1.7) drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(255,20,50,1))}
.sp-glow{position:absolute;inset:-10% -40%;background:radial-gradient(40% 30% at 50% 47%,rgba(255,20,50,.22),transparent 70%);opacity:0;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.sp-scan{position:absolute;left:14%;right:14%;top:0;height:2px;margin-top:-1px;opacity:0;transform:scaleX(.03);background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#ff3b52 30%,#fff 50%,#ff3b52 70%,transparent);box-shadow:0 0 14px 3px rgba(255,32,54,.7)}

#splash.play .sp-top i{animation:spExt var(--D) cubic-bezier(.5,0,.8,.6) forwards}

#splash.play .sp-main{animation:spMain var(--T) var(--D) linear forwards}
#splash.play .sp-scan{animation:spScan var(--T) var(--D) linear forwards}
#splash.play .sp-logo{animation:spLogo var(--T) var(--D) linear forwards}
#splash.play .sp-tip{animation:spTip calc(1.6s*var(--k)) calc(.5s*var(--k) + var(--T)*.64) ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#splash.play .sp-glow{animation:spGlow calc(3s*var(--k)) calc(.5s*var(--k) + var(--T)*.3) ease-out forwards}
